theme: 个股·主营业务与经营数据——万华化学2025年报营收构成（产品系列/区域拆分）

initial.question: 万华化学2025年年报里，聚氨酯系列产品实现的营业收入是多少？
initial.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(INCOME,2) FROM STK_PRI_INCOME_PRODUCT WHERE A_STOCKCODE='600309' AND ITEM_NAME='聚氨酯系列' AND PERIODDATE='2025-12-31' AND RPT_SRC='年报' AND RPT_TYPE='合并' AND ISVALID=1

feedbacks.question: 这块业务占了公司总营收多大比重？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(PRI_RVNU_PCT,2) FROM STK_PRI_INCOME_PRODUCT WHERE A_STOCKCODE='600309' AND ITEM_NAME='聚氨酯系列' AND PERIODDATE='2025-12-31' AND RPT_SRC='年报' AND RPT_TYPE='合并' AND ISVALID=1

feedbacks.question: 它的毛利率大概是什么水平？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(GP_RATIO,2) FROM STK_PRI_INCOME_PRODUCT WHERE A_STOCKCODE='600309' AND ITEM_NAME='聚氨酯系列' AND PERIODDATE='2025-12-31' AND RPT_SRC='年报' AND RPT_TYPE='合并' AND ISVALID=1

feedbacks.question: 再从地区维度拆一下，2025年来自国外的收入占比有多大？
feedbacks.gold_display: 47.39%（国外收入963.21亿元，仅次于中国大陆的52.19%）
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(PRI_RVNU_PCT,2) FROM STK_PRI_INCOME_DISTRICT WHERE A_STOCKCODE='600309' AND ITEM_NAME='国外' AND PERIODDATE='2025-12-31' AND RPT_SRC='年报' AND RPT_TYPE='合并' AND ISVALID=1

feedbacks.question: 那2024年呢？这块业务收入是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(INCOME,2) FROM STK_PRI_INCOME_PRODUCT WHERE A_STOCKCODE='600309' AND ITEM_NAME='聚氨酯系列' AND PERIODDATE='2024-12-31' AND RPT_SRC='年报' AND RPT_TYPE='合并' AND ISVALID=1

feedbacks.question: 换个标的看看，海康威视2025年年报的研发投入总额是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(RD_SUM,2) FROM STK_RD_DTL WHERE COMCODE=(SELECT COMCODE FROM GET_A_SEC_CODE WHERE SEC_CODE='002415' AND ISVALID=1 LIMIT 1) AND RPT_DATE='2025-12-31' AND ISVALID=1
